This template is SUBTRACTIVE. Start with everything, delete what you do not need.
That is easier than starting blank, because deleting a box forces you to say why.

1. Rename INPUT and OUTPUT to what they actually are.
2. Open the black box: keep only the inner boxes your system really has.
3. Rename each kept box after its RESPONSIBILITY, never a part you plan to buy.
4. Replace every [ ... ] label with what actually travels, its rate and units.
5. Check nothing draws power with no supply path drawn.

svg.text: SYSTEM BOUNDARY — rename. Inside = what you design. Outside = what you use.
THE BLACK BOX — open it up, then DELETE what you do not need
Works for any system: software, hardware, or both. It is SUBTRACTIVE — start with everything
here and delete what you do not need. Easier than a blank page, and deleting a box makes you say why.
1. Rename INPUT and OUTPUT to what they actually are.
2. Open the black box: keep only the inner boxes your system really has.
3. Rename each kept box after its RESPONSIBILITY, never a part or product you plan to use.
4. Replace every [ ... ] label with what actually travels, its rate and its units.
5. SOFTWARE-ONLY SYSTEM? Delete POWER SOURCE and MOUNTING, and write on the diagram
‘power and mechanical flow not applicable’. Saying so beats silently omitting it.
6. PHYSICAL SYSTEM? Check that nothing draws power with no supply path drawn.
7. Delete this note. Keep the legend.
